purpose: Synthetic IT scenarios for manual evidence and scoring calibration; not real company vacancies or AI ground truth.

cases.cv: Applying for Business Analyst. Captured requirements and wrote SRS for a booking product.
cases.jd: Business Analyst required: requirement elicitation and SRS documentation.
cases.expected: Only BA suggestions; both named skills have direct evidence.

cases.cv: Applying for Business Analyst. Made a Figma prototype; no SRS example.
cases.jd: Business Analyst required: SRS documentation; Figma preferred.
cases.expected: SRS NOT_EVIDENCED, Figma MET. Required missing evidence weighs twice preferred.

cases.cv: Work experience: Business Analyst. Current target: Backend Developer. Built Java APIs.
cases.jd: Backend Developer required: Java API implementation.
cases.expected: Use current explicit Backend target; do not select BA from employment history.

cases.cv: Applying for Backend Developer. Built Java REST APIs and SQL queries.
cases.jd: Backend Developer required: Java REST APIs and SQL queries.
cases.expected: Skill evidence MET; no invented Python or Kubernetes requirement.

cases.cv: Applying for Backend Developer. Built Java APIs as an intern for three months.
cases.jd: Senior Backend Developer required: five years of production Java experience.
cases.expected: Java evidence does not prove five years; seniority requirement not MET.

cases.cv: Applying for Backend Developer. Skills: Java; project details absent.
cases.jd: Backend Developer required: design and implement production Java APIs.
cases.expected: A named skill alone does not prove production delivery; reviewer decides PARTIAL versus NOT_EVIDENCED with quote.

cases.cv: Target Frontend Developer. Built React UI with accessible forms.
cases.jd: Frontend Developer required: React and accessible forms; testing preferred.
cases.expected: React/forms MET; testing NOT_EVIDENCED. Do not subtract education if JD does not require it.

cases.cv: Built React pages and TypeScript components. No application target stated.
cases.jd: Frontend Developer required: React and TypeScript components.
cases.expected: Suggest skill-based roles only after actual candidates are found; require user choice before scoring.

cases.cv: Applying for QA Engineer. Wrote test cases and automated regression with Selenium.
cases.jd: QA Engineer required: test cases and Selenium regression automation.
cases.expected: QA suggestions only; quoted evidence matches both requirements.

cases.cv: Target QA Engineer. Java API implementation project; testing evidence absent.
cases.jd: QA Engineer required: test automation and API testing.
cases.expected: Implementation is not evidence of API testing. An alternate Backend role is shown only after its actual assessment beats QA baseline.

cases.cv: Applying for Business Analyst. Captured stakeholder requirements.
cases.jd: We recruit a Business Analyst to capture stakeholder requirements and document user stories. Work with developers.
cases.expected: Resolve BA from content despite generic DB title. Developer collaboration does not label the JD Backend.

cases.cv: Applying for Backend Developer. Java project.
cases.jd: Join our friendly company. Many benefits and a welcoming culture.
cases.expected: No actual job requirements: insufficient evidence, no manufactured score, quota refunded if reserved.

reviewInstructions: Replace/extend with at least 12 representative full CV/JD pairs, manually label every actual requirement and exact evidence quote, compare totals and ordering, and record disagreements before marking calibration complete. Short scenarios above do not bypass production input validation.
